meaning:
ἄτιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX: Isa.3:5 (קָלָה ni.), Isa.53:3 (בָּזָה), Job.30:4, 8 (שֵׁם בְּלִי), שֵׁם בְּלִי), Wis.5:1-23, Sir.1:1-30 * ;]
without honour, dishonoured, despised: Mat.13:57, Mrk.6:4, 1Co.4:10; comp., 1Co.12:23.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.”
Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.
